ابتعثتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثْتُنَّ (ibtaʕaṯtunna) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثْتُنَّ (ubtuʕiṯtunna) /ub.tu.ʕiθ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
